overview_description.description: Resend is a software development company that specializes in providing developer-focused email solutions. The company offers an email API for developers, enabling them to build, test, and send transactional emails at scale. Resend's services are designed to make email sending easy and reliable, with features such as Dedicated IPs to improve deliverability. The company also provides documentation and support for integration with product offerings. In addition, Resend offers solutions for Laravel, providing two convenient ways to send emails using Laravel's email service or the Resend API facade.

about_short_description.short_description: Resend is an email API for developers.

product.name: Resend Email API
product.description: An API service that enables developers to send transactional and marketing emails programmatically using SDKs and REST or SMTP protocols.

product.name: Resend Webhooks
product.description: A service that delivers real-time notifications to servers about email events such as delivery, opens, clicks, bounces, and complaints.

product.name: Resend Email Editor
product.description: A web-based editor that allows users to visually create, format, and send emails with customizable styles and templates.

product.name: React Email Integration
product.description: An open-source React component library for building email templates without using traditional HTML table layouts.

product.name: Managed Dedicated IPs
product.description: A service providing dedicated IP addresses for email sending that automatically warm up and scale based on sending volume.

product.name: Proactive Blocklist Tracking
product.description: A monitoring service that alerts users if their domain is added to DNS-based blacklists and assists with removal requests.
